text.text: The Meraki MR53 combines 802.11ac Wave 2 with integrated Bluetooth for location analytics. This enterprise class Access Point provides exceptional performance thanks to its innovative use of multigigabit technology on its wired interfaces. MR53 is perfectly suited for performance-critical and high density Wireless environments.
